data_output.description: data.py must return encoded train and validation matrices with the existing five request-context categorical fields followed by bounded numeric sequential features: exponentially decayed prior long-view positive count, exponentially decayed prior negative count, and hours since the most recent positive interaction. Features for each impression must use only strictly earlier events, with validation initialized from training history only. Output row order must remain the canonical loader validation order, and labels must not be exposed to the evaluator.

model_input.description: model.py must accept the augmented two-dimensional feature matrix produced by data.py, retain pointwise BCE factorization-machine scoring, and produce one finite score per input row in unchanged order. Numeric history features must be consumed without target leakage; categorical offsets and feature dimensions must remain compatible with training-only vocabularies.
